profile.headline: A drop of fresh blood in Software Engineer pool @ Microsoft
profile.summary:
I am now working full-time at Microsoft as a Software Engineer.

I earned my Master's degree from Carnegie Mellon University's Heinz College, majoring in Information Systems Management - Business Intelligence & Data Analytics (MISM-BIDA) in Dec 2022 and my Bachelor of Science degree in Computer Science from University of Washington in March 2021. 

I have a strong passion for technology and abilities to adapt to new environments. I enjoy learning new skills and communicating with others. I am open and eager to learn and work in various branches of Computer Science. I am interested in working in areas related to artificial intelligence, cloud computing and infrastructure, software development, robotics, and machine learning.

positions.title: Software Engineer I / II
positions.description: Shipped Core Azure Local Migration Services: Engineered and launched the GA service product for VMware VM Migration and the Public Preview engine for Hyper-V VM Migration to the Azure Local platform.
positions.insights: Skills: Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Software Infrastructure · Exploratory Data Analysis · Azure DevOps Services · Microsoft Azure

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: This was a new chapter at Microsoft interning under C&AI, Azure Edge + Platform, working under Azure Stack HCI to enhance the system's testability. My work was built on top of the existing Azure NFS service, it would enable the testing of many customer scenarios like never before. With the mechanism built, the team would be able to improve the stability of Azure file NFS service, reduce the live site incidents, and improve customer satisfaction.

positions.title: Full-stack Technical Intern
positions.description: During my internship at OCI, I was in charge of the creation of a new table in the existing database and the implementation of its associated API's in Java as well as the creation of seven new React pages on the existing internal security platform and associated unit tests. I worked closely with two different engineering teams to accomplish my assigned tasks.

positions.title: Undergraduate Student Researcher in Personal Robotics Laboratory
positions.description: My main task in the Food Manipulation Project was to automate the food acquirement process by applying Bayesian combination between vision system (image from camera) and haptics system (data read in from force-torque sensor), so that the robot could determine the successfulness of the food acquirement with 95% confidence.

company.name: University of Washington School of Computer Science & Engineering

positions.title: Undergraduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description: As an Undergraduate Teaching Assistant for a CSE courses at University of Washington, I prepared and conducted review sections for a class of approximately 20 students twice a week. I also assisted students in weekly office hours, managed and responded to course-related e-mail and discussion sites, and graded assignments and exams, and provided individual feedback.

company.name: University of Washington Computer Science & Engineering Department

positions.title: Mobile Application Developer Intern
positions.description: As a Mobile Application Developer summer intern, I initialized minder mobile client project and integrated the existing web client to adapt the mobile environment, using React Native, React Redux and Redux-Saga.
positions.insights: Skills: React Native · Front-End Development · Mobile Applications

positions.title: Undergraduate Student Researcher in Autonomous Flight Systems Laboratory

company.name: University of Washington Department of Aeronautics and Astronautics
Rockhurst High School Robotics Team, Jesubot

volunteerExperiences.description: As a volunteer, I had the opportunity to read book requests from incarcerated individuals, to search through Books to Prisoners' library of books to find the perfect fit, and eventually to fulfill those requests by sending requestors those books. I volunteered along side with individuals, students, court-ordered community service volunteers, and small groups, and was able to contribute to the work of human rights.
